# AgentSec Triage

AgentSec Triage turns sourced intelligence about developer,
software-supply-chain, and coding-agent attacks into deterministic checks over
explicit local repository roots. Scans are read-only and offline by default.
They report findings, diagnostics, exclusions, per-detector coverage, and
incomplete checks; they never certify a repository or system as clean.
